extras: Distributed as a manual-install preview ZIP; relies on Obsidian's file explorer internals and an Electron bridge that may change in an Obsidian update. Folders in the selection are left to Obsidian, and all processing is local with no telemetry or account.
intentEvidence: If you installed the Windows File Drag or local macOS preview, disable it before enabling Native File Drag.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer cannot hand notes or attachments to the operating system, so getting them into other apps means leaving Obsidian.
